title: Approve a landing composition
question: Nursery Apothecary Shelf is locked. Which composition should we build? Say what to keep, what feels false, or ask for a combine/revise.

options.label: Arch Aperture
options.body: Full-bleed arched still-life as the first viewport. Brand + headline + Book sit in the lower third. Modalities peek below as a shelf row. Closest to the studio’s backlit-arch architecture — strongest brand memory test.

options.label: Shelf Horizon
options.body: Wide horizontal station shelf as the hero plane. Brand and copy above; Book placed on the shelf edge. Reads most literally as an apothecary shelf. Risk: less dramatic than the arch.

options.label: Ritual Descent
options.body: Edge-to-edge station close-up with plaster band for type, then modalities as an inventory list and booking as a connected ritual flow. Strongest full-page system proof. Risk: denser; hero brand must stay large in build.
